title: Allow removing stale plan requests
summary: Added a stale-only dismiss path for Plan requests. The localhost API can mark stale requests as dismissed while preserving the private audit record, and the macOS approval app now shows a Remove stale plan action that refreshes the queue after success.
userVisibleChange: Stale plans in the approval window can now be removed from the visible queue.

risks.title: Unrelated cmd/eve/main.go worktree change was present while recording
risks.mitigation: The stale-plan implementation was already committed; the unrelated change was preserved and not staged into this implementation commit.

risks.title: Automated code-review agents timed out before returning findings
risks.mitigation: The diff was manually inspected and covered by focused API, Swift, full Go, and Xcode validation.

decisions.title: Dismiss instead of deleting stale request files
decisions.rationale: Stale plan requests are local audit records; changing their state preserves history while removing them from review queues.

decisions.title: Make dismissal stale-only
decisions.rationale: Pending approvable plans still require approve, reject, or staleness; remove is only for terminal stale clutter.

decisions.title: Use expected revision on dismiss
decisions.rationale: Dismiss follows the existing mutation conflict model and avoids acting on stale UI state.

validation.command: xcodebuild -quiet -project EVEApproval.xcodeproj -scheme EVEApproval -configuration Release -destination platform=macOS -derivedDataPath /tmp/eve-xcode-derived-remove-stale-build build
